summary.text: Sam Watson, a Republican, has served in the Georgia State Senate since 2023, representing Senate District 11.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Watson previously served five terms in the Georgia House of Representatives representing House District 172.
The biography says he is a past president of the Georgia Fruit and Vegetable Growers Association and lives on the family farm in southern Colquitt County, between Moultrie and Coolidge.
